notes: Private opcode-dispatch field decoder for a single 'SpotAnimVector' entry (Class174 - a particle/force-field effect applied to nearby SpriteRenderEntry particles, per ProjectileNode.kt cross-reference). opcode 1: anInt2302 = direction/cone-angle unit (later used in method1337 as an index into the class's own 16384-entry cosine table, `anInt2302 shl 3` -- 2048*8=16384, matching the classic OSRS 11-bit 0..2047 orientation convention). opcode 2: reads and discards one byte (decoy/reserved). opcode 3: anInt2291/anInt2290/anInt2294 = raw (x,y,z) force-vector components (their magnitude is computed in method1337 as anInt2299). opcode 4: anInt2289 = falloff-type byte (1=linear,2=quadratic per method1337/ProjectileNode.method2524 usage) and anInt2304 = falloff scale. opcode 6 (the trailing 'else' of the if-chain): anInt2296 = vector 'type' byte -- confirmed significant via SpotAnimDefCache.method1943, which only registers the vector into its shared id-lookup table when anInt2296==2, and via ProjectileNode.method2524 which skips vectors with anInt2296==1 (`class174.anInt2296 != 1`) when scanning nearby particles. opcode 8: anInt2297=1 (flag distinguishing 'accumulate into shared displacement' vs 'apply directly to this entity', see method2524). opcode 9: anInt2292=1 (flag distinguishing 'attract toward raw xyz offset' vs 'push along the normalized direction at magnitude anInt2299', see method2524). opcode 10: aBoolean2308=true (inverts/repels; anInt2299 is negated for it in method1337). Opcodes 5 and 7 are not handled by any branch (no bytes consumed) -- likely unused/removed opcodes in this revision. The trailing `if (i_8_ >= -124) aLong2301 = 65L` is a dead/opaque branch in practice: the only caller (method1336) always passes revision=-128 (Byte), which is always < -124, so this assignment never executes for any real data.

Reads opcode bytes from buffer in a loop until a 0 terminator, delegating each to decodeField(buffer, opcode, -128) (revision byte hardcoded, see decodeField notes for why that renders one of its branches dead). After the loop, increments the companion counter anInt2288 and applies a revision-gated default: `if (revision <= 36) anInt2296 = 8` (force 'type' to 8 for pre-rev37 data lacking opcode 6). The sole call site (SpotAnimDefCache.method1943) always passes revision=83, so this default branch is always false/dead in the current data set, but the pattern (unlike the decoy in decodeField) plausibly reflects genuine backward-compatibility logic for older cache revisions rather than pure obfuscator noise.

Post-decode step that derives runtime fields from the raw decoded values. anInt2298 = cosine-table lookup (anIntArray1204, the class's own 16384-entry cos table) at index `anInt2302 shl 3` -- the cosine of the configured cone/direction angle, later compared against a scaled dot-product in ProjectileNode.method2524 to test whether a particle lies within this vector's directional cone. anInt2299 = 3D magnitude of the (anInt2291,anInt2290,anInt2294) vector via sqrt(dx^2+dy^2+dz^2). Ensures anInt2304 (falloff scale) is never 0. Computes aLong2301 (an effective squared-radius/cutoff used in ProjectileNode.method2524 as `d_45_ > aLong2301` to reject out-of-range particles) from anInt2299/anInt2304 when anInt2289 (falloff type) is 1 (linear, then squared) or 2 (quadratic-ish), or sets it to Int.MAX_VALUE (no cutoff) when anInt2289==0 -- gated by `anInt2289.inv() != i`, which for the sole call site's constant argument -1 is equivalent to testing `anInt2289 != 0` (since only 0.inv()==-1); the `i` parameter is effectively a fixed sentinel matching an obfuscated inv()-comparison rather than a meaningful runtime input (only ever called with -1, from SpotAnimDefCache.method1943). Finally negates anInt2299 if aBoolean2308 (the 'invert/repel' flag from decodeField opcode 10) is set.
